title: hieracium lanuginosum
intro: Hieracium lanuginosum, commonly known as woolly hawk's-beard, is a species of flowering plant in the dandelion family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to soothe digestive issues, reduce pain and inflammation, and support immune function. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium lanuginosum include its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce fever, and act as a diuretic, making it a potential remedy for various ailments. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
